draft.letter_text: Dear Prime Video, I am disputing the charge of $9.99 on my card for the month of [insert month]. I did not use your service during this period and would like this charge reversed. Please investigate and cancel any future charges. Sincerely, [Your Name]
steps: Check your account for any evidence of use during the disputed month
Contact Prime Video's merchant support to explain the issue
Escalate to Your bank's dispute team if Prime Video does not resolve the issue
Provide documentation to support your claim if requested
Wait for a response from Prime Video or Your bank's dispute team
Follow up with a phone call if you do not receive a response within 7 days
Cancel the subscription from the app's account page to stop future charges.

reason: Charged for a month I did not use
